mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where RSAFS increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points within a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2 percentage points within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals increased economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% each within a month signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS increase > 5% each in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by more than 5% each within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 within a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where PAYEMS decreased by more than 100,000 within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over three consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which leads to increased costs and reduced corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 2% each within a quarter signals strong economic growth and consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST increase > 2% each in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST increased by more than 2% each within a quarter.
